title: Sevginin Dili
author: Esat Zorkirişçi
description: Love is building bridges between our differences. How do you show your love to a flower, a cat, an ant, or a human? Sara is a special child who speaks with her hands and listens with her eyes. Her little brother searches for a unique way to show how much he loves his big sister and discovers various ways to express love. This emotional journey teaches him the power of connection, both in Sara’s language and in his own.
